title: Blueprint Recipes: the 14 plant-based meals Bryan Johnson eats
summary: Bryan Johnson lists 14 recipes he's been eating lately, calling food one of life's greatest joys. They are plant-based dishes built around vegetables, lentils, chickpeas, mushrooms, cauliflower and squash, with weighed gram quantities, olive oil, nuts and seeds, plus a porridge and a berry smoothie. The essay gives ingredients only and no stated principles.

principles.text: Bryan treats eating as one of life's greatest joys, so his meals are enjoyable, not just functional.
principles.quote: Here’s a list of the recipes I’ve been eating lately. One of life’s greatest joys for me.

principles.text: His meals are built around vegetables, legumes and mushrooms, such as stir fry, lentil soup and chickpea stew.
principles.quote: Vegetable Stir Fry with Cauliflower Rice

principles.text: He swaps grains for cauliflower rice, spaghetti squash and chickpea flour or chickpea rice.
principles.quote: Mushroom and Walnut Bolognese with Spaghetti Squash

principles.text: He measures many ingredients in grams, with olive oil as the main cooking fat.
He eats a grain-free porridge of nut milk, almond flour, hemp, chia and flax, plus a berry smoothie with nuts and seeds.
principles.quote: Grain Free Porridge with Butterfly Pea Flower
